references.text: Balak sends a message to Balaam with the same request to curse the people who have come out of Egypt, for they cover the land.
Balaam refers to Balak's request to curse Jacob and Israel, but declares that he cannot curse anyone whom God has not cursed.
Pharaoh expresses similar fear over Israel's growing population and wants to fight them before they become too numerous.
The expression about covering the face of the earth (עֵין הָאָרֶץ) is also used regarding the plague of locusts in Egypt.
Balak repeats his request to Balaam to curse the people.
Instead of a curse, Balaam prophesies about Israel's strength and blessing, the opposite of what Balak desired.
God turned Balaam's curse into a blessing because the Lord loved Israel.
